messages:
sasha: heads-up, ran regression on SM90 w/ flashv3 -> sdpa fallback for causal; ~20% p99 increase on some prompts :frowning:
priya: do you have a short repro + perf log?
sasha: yep. repro script below. small batch (1) seqlen 512 + varied head_dim shows non-monotonic perf. env: `USE_FLASH=1 USE_SDPA_FALLBACK=1`

sasha: bench numbers (opt-1.3b):
```
seq=512 bsz=1 heads=22 hd=22 perf(ms): flashv3=11.2 sdpa=14.8
heads=44 hd=44 perf(ms): flashv3=12.6 sdpa=15.1
heads=88 hd=88 perf(ms): flashv3=13.0 sdpa=16.2
heads=32 hd=32 perf(ms): flashv3=11.9 sdpa=17.9  <-- big jump
```

sasha: root cause looks like KV cache warmup + kernel chooser hysteresis. when head_dim % 16 != 0 the kernel probe sometimes prefers sdpa which triggers heavier L2 activity and memcpy stalls.
max: can you paste profiler flame?
sasha: short trace: `mem_bw spike @ kv_warmup` and `cuda memcpy async stalled`. autotuner logs: 
```
[autotuner] probe head=32 seqlen=512 -> score_flashv3=0.74 score_sdpa=0.76 choose=sdpa (delta 0.02)
[autotuner] hysteresis applied prev=flashv3 window=5 -> chose sdpa
```
linus: interesting, so probe noise flips decision. we should widen hysteresis or add arch-aware penalty for SM90 on non-64-aligned head dims.
sasha: forced `FORCE_KERNEL=flashv3` -> perf stable and p99 back to baseline, but forcing globally is not ideal.
priya: plan: add tiny regularization to autotuner: prefer flash path when delta < 0.03 unless mem_bw > threshold; also include a KV-warmup pass in the probe (run a short dummy forward to populate KV caches).
rachel: please create a ticket and attach traces + bench output.
sasha: done: https://r.infra/tickets/IF-6421
perf-bot: nightly-bench posted for commit abc123 (2026-03-15)
perf-bot: summary: +12% p95 on causal long tails for heads in {28,32,48}. full logs: https://bench.r.infra/abc123
priya: I'll prototype the autotuner patch tomorrow and add a gated rollout with runtime tests.
sasha: thanks — doing a temporary revert for vulnerable customers now. :thumbsup:
jamie: add note to release notes and runbook about `FORCE_KERNEL` env var as an emergency knob.
sasha: will do, and I'll link the ticket in the PR.
